about: Production dependencies whose licence the checker cannot accept on its own, each reviewed. `licence` pins the declared value the review covered: if the package changes its licence, the exception stops applying and the check fails again.

ssh2.reason: MIT (LICENSE file in the package); lockfile entry has no license field. ADR 0007.

cpu-features.reason: MIT (LICENSE file); optional native helper of ssh2, no license field in the lockfile.

buildcheck.reason: MIT (LICENSE file); build helper of cpu-features, no license field in the lockfile.

duck.reason: declared as bare "BSD"; LICENSE file is the 2-clause BSD text (no endorsement clause). Dependency of mammoth.
